_comment: The set of GitHub Actions jobs that must have concluded 'success' before
infra/systemd/newme-deploy.sh will deploy a commit to production.
Why a manifest and not a list inside the wrapper: the wrapper reads this file
out of the root-owned release mirror at the canonical main SHA being deployed
(`git --git-dir=/opt/newme/repository.git show <main-sha>:infra/release/required-jobs.json`),
so the required set is versioned with the release it gates and cannot be
loosened on the host without changing main. A local edit to this file in a
working copy has no effect on a deployment.
Why job conclusions and not the run conclusion: a workflow run is 'success'
when none of the jobs that RAN failed. Jobs skipped by an `if:` condition do
not make the run anything other than green, so 'run.conclusion == success'
answers 'nothing that ran failed', never 'everything that had to run, ran'.
The reviewed revision of the wrapper checked only the run and accepted a
push event, while the explicit predeploy taskboard job runs only on a manual
release-candidate dispatch. The accepted run shape therefore could not carry
the required predeploy set.
Release-final taskboard completion is intentionally not listed here. It runs
after production evidence exists, at a later closure SHA, and is governed by
infra/release/final-required-jobs.json plus check-release-closure.mjs. Making
that postdeploy fact a precondition of this release would be circular.

required_jobs.name: Repository validation
required_jobs.why: taskboard, spec, lint, supply-chain, database-types, typecheck, unit tests, release hygiene, production smoke and build

required_jobs.name: Windows checkout and SPEC gate
required_jobs.why: the SPEC gate under a case-insensitive filesystem and CRLF checkout; reachable on the release-candidate dispatch

required_jobs.name: Predeploy taskboard readiness
required_jobs.why: every predeploy_ready TASKBOARD row is closed at the exact release SHA; postdeploy rows remain independently gated

required_jobs.name: Control-plane restore interruption drill
required_jobs.why: the candidate control plane is restorable after SIGTERM during atomic copy, repeated restore converges, and bootstrap finalization leaves no pending asset transaction

required_jobs.name: Narrow task follow-up database contract
required_jobs.why: pgTAP contract under supabase/ci-local, with the reset verified twice

required_jobs.name: Migration replay and release contracts
required_jobs.why: migration history immutability, negative control, full branch replay with behaviour assertions, rollback state assertions, recorded history failure point

notes: tolerated_conclusions is exhaustive on purpose: 'skipped', 'neutral' and
'stale' are refused for a required job, and no job in the run may have
concluded anything other than success or skipped. A required job that is
absent from the run is refused by name. Release-final taskboard completion is
intentionally not a deploy precondition; it is required only after production
has produced the evidence needed to close postdeploy acceptance rows.
